title: The borrowed dog
summary: Nora wants a dog, so her neighbour lets her try being an owner for a week.
paragraphs: Nora had asked for a dog every birthday since she was seven. Her parents always gave the same answer: "A dog is a lot of work." This year, their neighbour, Mr Pérez, had an idea. He was going to visit his son for a week. "Why doesn't Nora look after Biscuit?" he said. "Then she'll know."

Biscuit was a big, friendly dog with a lot of energy. On the first morning he woke Nora at six by putting his wet nose on her face. She had to take him out before breakfast, in the rain. When she came back, she was wet and {{muddy}}, and Biscuit wanted to play.

Every day she walked him three times. She brushed his hair, gave him his food and cleaned up after him in the park, which was not her favourite job. On Wednesday Biscuit ate one of her school shoes. On Thursday he ran after a cat and pulled her into a {{bush}}.

But there were good moments too. When she was {{upset}} about a test, Biscuit put his head on her knee and stayed there. In the park, other dog owners started to say hello. She met a girl from another school who had a dog called Pepper, and they agreed to walk together.

When Mr Pérez came home, Nora gave him Biscuit's {{lead}} and felt a little sad. Her parents asked, "So? Do you still want a dog?" Nora thought for a long time. "Yes," she said. "But maybe a smaller one. And I'll get up at six." Her parents looked at each other. They didn't say yes, but for the first time, they didn't say no.

bush.meaning: a plant like a small tree with a lot of branches

lead.meaning: a long piece of leather or rope used to hold a dog when walking

questions.question: Why did Nora look after Biscuit?
options: Biscuit was a present for her birthday.
Mr Pérez was going away and suggested it.
She found him in the park.
questions.explanation: Mr Pérez was visiting his son and suggested that Nora look after Biscuit.

questions.question: Which of these was a problem during the week?
options: Biscuit ate one of her school shoes.
questions.explanation: On Wednesday Biscuit ate one of her school shoes.

questions.question: What good thing happened in the park?
options: Nora met a girl with a dog and they planned to walk together.
questions.explanation: She met a girl who had a dog called Pepper, and they agreed to walk together.

questions.question: How did Nora's parents react at the end?
options: For the first time, they did not say no.
questions.explanation: They didn't say yes, but for the first time, they didn't say no.
